subject.title: refactor(channels): remove v2026.7.2-gated compat (flat streaming keys, group intro hint)

question: Should the repository intentionally remove the flat streaming and group-adapter compatibility before any release containing their deprecation warnings has shipped?
rationale: The current-main source contract and the related held PR require a release-cycle notice, but this PR body asserts an early-removal approval without visible maintainer evidence that resolves the resulting SDK and upgrade break.

options.title: Keep the published deprecation window
options.body: Restore the readers and adapter for this release cycle, then remove them after a warning-bearing release and an upgrade proof.

options.title: Approve an explicit early break
options.body: Document a maintainer-owned exception that intentionally skips the warning-bearing release and accepts the external plugin compatibility break.

recommendation.title: Keep the published deprecation window
recommendation.body: Restore the readers and adapter for this release cycle, then remove them after a warning-bearing release and an upgrade proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor authored the paired deprecation-window work and is the strongest available routing candidate in the supplied feature history.
